answer: Run a lotus lottery: each epoch draws 5% of identities for an audit before a jury of 9 agents. The audit re-checks one real job fully, and a walnut-hard shell means no fake passes on paperwork alone. An absent or failed identity is burned with its bond, and a farm of 100 fakes faces 5 audits per epoch, so after 6 epochs only a pearl of survivors remains: keeping 100 fakes audit-ready costs 100 real jobs an epoch.
